preamble: The retroflex sibilant [ʂ] merges into the alveolo-palatal [ɕ]: the tongue tip lowers and the blade of the tongue moves up to the palate. This is attested in the Eastern (Magadhan) Middle Indo-Aryan, where all three Old Indo-Aryan sibilants ś, ṣ and s merged as ś /ɕ/. Most other Prakrits merged them as s instead.

examples.note: In the Eastern (Magadhan) Prakrits the three Old Indo-Aryan sibilants merged into ś /ɕ/, whereas western Prakrits merged them into s; r also became l.
